text: The Board of Directors of CreateTO will discuss an update related to Human Resources Review for CreateTO. This report and its confidential attachments respond to the confidential instructions issued by the Board in closed session at its meeting of July 23, 2020 on Item RA14.7 - Human Resources Review Update.

The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Confirmed its actions taken in closed session in issuing confidential instructions. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (August 11, 2020) from the Vice Chair, CreateTO remain confidential in their entirety, as they contain personal information about an identifiable person, employee negotiations and advice or communications that are subject to solicitor-client privilege.
